title: Perplexity Staircase
one_liner: Drag a model down the log-perplexity scale and watch capability thresholds unlock, from chat to millennium-prize math.
headline: Drag a vertical slider down the log-perplexity scale and watch a model's capability thresholds — fluent chat, thinking before answering, solving a millennium-prize problem — light up one by one.

episode.title: Jensen Huang Is Back: Inside NVIDIA’s $1 Trillion Comeback After 11 Days Out | EP #315

history.summary: A clean, self-contained single-idea toy that faithfully reproduces the episode's log-perplexity staircase, with correctly attributed podcast figures, a clearly labeled illustrative plateau overlay, and solid mobile/accessibility handling. No dependencies, no console errors, and all five acceptance criteria check out against the code and screenshots. It's a smaller, quieter demo than some — the word fan's numeric range is modest and the most interesting overlay is tucked behind a button — but it's honest, correct, and ready to publish as-is.
